# medikamio

> > A multilingual medication database and health information platform providing comprehensive drug information, disease references, and health articles across 10+ European countries.

medikamio is a personal medicine assistant offering searchable databases of 2,500-15,000+ medications depending on region, complete with dosage information, active ingredients, side effects, and disease correlations. The platform serves users across the UK, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, and Portugal with localized pharmaceutical content.

## Key Topics

- Medication Database
- Drug Information
- Active Ingredients
- Disease Reference
- Side Effects
- Dosage Guide
- Package Inserts
- Multilingual Health
- Pharmaceutical Guide
- Health Articles
- Paracetamol
- Migraine
- Alzheimer
- afgis Certification
- Medicine Assistant

## Medication Databases by Region

- [UK Medications](https://medikamio.com/en-gb/drugs): Search database of 2,800+ UK medications with patient information
- [German Medications](https://medikamio.com/de-de/medikamente): German medication database with 14,000+ drugs from Austria
- [Austrian Medications](https://medikamio.com/de-at/medikamente): Austrian medication database with 14,000+ drugs and dosage info
- [Swiss German Medications](https://medikamio.com/de-ch/medikamente): Swiss German medication database with 14,000+ drugs
- [Swiss French Medications](https://medikamio.com/fr-ch/medicaments): French Swiss medication database with 2,500+ drugs from France
- [French Medications](https://medikamio.com/fr-fr/medicaments): French medication database with 2,500+ drugs from France
- [Dutch Medications](https://medikamio.com/nl-nl/geneesmiddelen): Dutch medication database with 15,000+ drugs from Netherlands
- [Spanish Medications](https://medikamio.com/es-es/medicamentos): Spanish medication database with 6,000+ Spanish drug inserts
- [Portuguese Medications](https://medikamio.com/pt-pt/medicamentos): Portuguese medication database with 8,000+ drugs
- [Italian Medications](https://medikamio.com/it-it/farmaci): Italian medication database with 2,500+ drugs from Italy

## Health Reference & Information

- [Diseases & Symptoms](https://medikamio.com/en-gb/diseases): Directory of 14,000+ drugs with disease and symptom information
- [Active Ingredients](https://medikamio.com/en-gb/substances): Reference guide for active ingredients with dosage and interactions

## Health & Medical Articles

- [Magazine](https://medikamio.com/en-gb/magazine): Health articles and medical research updates on medications
- [Migraine Treatment Advances](https://medikamio.com/de-de/magazin/neue-erkenntnisse-bei-der-behandlung-von-migrane): Article on migraine research and new drug treatments
- [STDs in Europe](https://medikamio.com/de-de/magazin/sexuell-ubertragbare-krankheiten-europa-eine-wachsende-herausforderung): Article on STDs in Europe and prevention strategies
- [COVID-19 Vaccine Development](https://medikamio.com/de-de/magazin/aktuelle-entwicklungen-rund-um-neue-corona-impfstoffe): Article on COVID-19 vaccine development and clinical trials
- [Sleep Deprivation & Women's Health](https://medikamio.com/de-de/magazin/auswirkungen-der-schlafbeschrankung-auf-frauen): Article on sleep deprivation effects on women's health
- [Exercise & Asthma Control](https://medikamio.com/de-de/magazin/kann-regelmassige-bewegung-die-asthmakontrolle-verbessern): Article on exercise benefits for asthma control and management
